`/desk-activity` now draws agents you start after a turn ends, like the built-in `/code-review`.

- An agent started from a slash command opens no turn, so the pane kept the last turn and dropped the agent because it began after that turn ended. It now gets its own lane and agent row, with its calls, for as long as that turn is the one on show
- Time when nothing ran (a minute or more, such as the wait between the turn and that agent) folds into one `┆` column across all lanes, so the main lane keeps its width. The legend ends with the folded time (`┆ 1m 24s idle`); the axis end and the flow times stay real

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
